observation_summary: The CollectionUtils.removeAll method returned a collection containing elements that should have been removed, causing assertion failures in tests expecting the removal of specific items.
reasoning_summary: The bug report and the fix diff clearly indicate that the CollectionUtils.removeAll method was incorrectly calling ListUtils.retainAll instead of ListUtils.removeAll. This logic error caused the method to perform an intersection operation (retaining elements) rather than a subtraction operation (removing elements), leading to incorrect collection sizes and contents as observed in the failing test case.
